      "evidence_grade": "platform_official",
      "anchor": "are out of scope for this document",

      "evidence_grade": "platform_official",
      "anchor": "The activity associated with generation",
      "location": "w3c-dcat-3#c0016"

      "anchor": "fully informationally equivalent",
      "location": "w3c-dcat-3#c0016"
    },

      "claim_text": "As a counter-example, budget data for different years would usually be modeled as different datasets, each with their own distributions, since all distributions of one dataset should broadly contain the same data.",

      "evidence_grade": "platform_official",

      "location": "w3c-dcat-3#c0016"

      "location": "w3c-dcat-3#c0016"
